'''Giovanni Sansone''' (24 May 1888 – 13 October 1979) was an Italian [[mathematician]], known for his works on [[mathematical analysis]], on the [[Orthogonal functions|theory of orthogonal functions]] and on the [[Ordinary differential equation|theory of ordinary differential equations]].<ref>{{in lang|it}} [http://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/giovanni-sansone_%28Enciclopedia-Italiana%29/ SANSONE, Giovanni], ''[[Enciclopedia Italiana]]'' - II Appendice (1949)</ref>

He was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Bologna in 1928.<ref>Sansone, G. "Nuove formule risolutive delle congruenze cubiche." In ''Atti del Congresso Internazionale dei Matematici: Bologna del 3 al 10 de settembre di 1928'', vol. 2, pp. 13-16. 1929.</ref>
